edges.quote: The operator, Feri Rambai Lintas, keeps the route on its current timetable of eleven sailings a day.

Under the notice, the operator absorbs the difference from three places named in its own filing: the roster allowance paid on sailings after eight in the evening, the hold charge on the two morning runs that carry medical boxes out to the Pulau Randu clinic under an old side agreement, and the settlement window with its fuel wholesaler, which the filing extends from thirty days to ninety.
The Rambai Transport Office capped the island ferry fare at Rp12,000 from 1 April and said the measure carries no charge against the city budget.
